title: A worker bump to the latest security release of its own line while a sibling service stays on another supported line at its latest release (clean control: no numeric comparison across lines)

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
w = open("worker/Dockerfile").read()
a = open("api/Dockerfile").read()
assert "node:24.22.1-bookworm-slim@sha256:" in w and "node:22.23.4-bookworm-slim@sha256:" in a

PYEND
